name: Blunderbuss of the Grinning Sinner
summary: A musket that never needs loading and makes its own Necrotic shot, +1 (+2 at level 7, +3 at 13). Jinxshot trades one attack for a 30-ft Cone. From level 7, Sinner's Jinx: once a turn its damage curses a creature that fails a Charisma save, 1d4 off its D20 Tests for a minute (one creature at a time).

powers.name: Jinxshot
powers.text: In place of one attack, a 30-ft Cone of grave-shot: a Dexterity save against 16 + the bonus, 2d4 Necrotic (3d6 from level 7), half on a success.
